[[Antiquated Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] obtained from the [[Dragrimmar Chest]] that appears after defeating [[Remnant of Antiquities]] in the [[Sepulchre of Dragrimmar]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Water Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Water Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica for this item with:
*[[Frost Artifact]] from collector [[Mitigan Backbreaker]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Forget Me Not]]" inscription
OR
*[[Frost Artifact]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Forget Me Not]]" inscription
AND
*Yellow [[dye]]
